symptom: Every user task written with AutoAssignSingleTargetUser = false; no MDL clause, not in describe, and create or modify workflow turned off a box ticked in Studio Pro — completing the task from a microflow then failed at runtime with 'it is not assigned to you'; check and mx check silent
cause: userTaskToGen wrote addBool(g, "AutoAssignSingleTargetUser", false) as a constant (the MCP route sent the same literal); the reader never read the property, so the rewrite guard, which counts stored settings, had nothing to compare
insight: This is the 'loss set is every constant the rebuild writes' audit from rewrite-drops-unauthored-state, missed for a property that sat one line above the guarded AwaitAllUsers: grep the writer for addBool/addStr with a literal and each hit is a candidate. Studio Pro's default for a NEW task is false (Model SDK default false; ako/TestApp 11.14.0 stores false on all three of its user tasks), so the default was right and only the reset was wrong — the fix is restate-or-refuse like await all users, not a changed default. A carry (keep stored value when omitted) was the reporter's ask but cannot work for a presence-only boolean clause: omission could then never turn it off. On mxcli-authored content the stored value IS the constant, so only a fixture with the flag set to true can show the bug.
